english.title: Threaten use of noxious substance - terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a threat, designed to influence the government or to intimidate the public or a section of the public, that

(A)_[you]_
(B)_[another, namely **(..SPECIFY..),]_

would take action involving the use of a noxious substance or other noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY..), which had or was likely to

(C)_[cause serious violence against a person anywhere in the world,]_
(D)_[cause serious damage to real or personal property anywhere in the world,]_
(E)_[have the effect of endangering human life or creating a serious risk to the health or safety of the public or a section of the public,]_
(F)_[have the effect of inducing in members of the public the fear that the action was likely to endanger their lives or create a serious risk to their health or safety,]_

intending thereby to induce in a person anywhere in the world the fear that the threat was likely to be carried out
english.legislation: Contrary to section 113(3), and (4) of the Anti-Terrorism, Crime and Security Act 2001.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence may be committed against the public anywhere in the world

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
